title: Learned Control Variates for Rare Grid-Outage Estimation at Electric Vehicle Charging Stations
abstract: arXiv:2610.27159v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Public charging of electric vehicles (EVs) adds a large and synchronized load to the distribution feeders. In most networks, it is rare to overload a feeder at the same time. When it does happen, the consequences can be severe: an overloaded feeder stresses its transformers and can trigger cascading outages across a city. Planners who design for high reliability therefore need to estimate very small outage probabilities. To that end, plain Monte Carlo estimation with an expensive grid simulator can require a prohibitively large number of runs for this task. translated_title: 用于电动汽车充电站罕见电网停电估计的学习控制变量
translated_abstract: 电动汽车（EV）的公共充电为配电馈线带来了大量且同步的负荷。在大多数电网中，馈线同时过载的情况是罕见的，但一旦发生，后果可能非常严重：过载的馈线会使变压器承受巨大压力，并可能在整个城市范围内引发连锁停电事故。因此，追求高可靠性的电网规划者需要估计极小的停电概率。为此，使用昂贵的电网模拟器进行普通蒙特卡洛估计可能需要多得令人望而却步的运行次数。为了减少运行次数，我们提出了一种由停电分类器构建的控制变量（CV），该分类器使用温度和负荷预测等廉价的、可观测的特征进行训练。我们证明，对于任何二分类学习器，方差缩减是其召回率和假阳性率的显式函数。此外，我们还证明了基于高斯代理的控制变量……
tldr: 本文提出利用基于廉价可观测特征（如温度和负荷预测）训练的停电分类器构建控制变量，将任意二分类学习器的召回率和假阳性率与方差缩减显式关联，从而大幅减少电动汽车充电站罕见电网停电概率估计所需的昂贵蒙特卡洛模拟次数。
en_tdlr: Proposes a control variate built from a learned outage classifier trained on cheap observable features, proving that variance reduction is an explicit function of the learner's recall and false-positive rate, thus drastically reducing the expensive Monte Carlo simulations needed to estimate rare grid outages caused by EV charging stations.
